task.name: put_stapler_top_drawer_and_close
task.description: Use the left arm to put the blue stapler into the top drawer, and then use the right arm to pull close the top drawer.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the blue stapler.
2. Grasp the blue stapler with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the top drawer.
4. Release the gripper to place the blue stapler into the top drawer.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the top drawer.
6. Pull close the top drawer using the right arm.
